title: Mathematical Modeling & Capstone
description: Study dimensional analysis, sensitivity analysis, assumptions and model mismatch, and capstone: audit an optimization experiment. Each lesson includes a worked example and an applied practice task.

lessons.title: Dimensional analysis
lessons.description: Rewrite the calculation using service time and arrival rate with compatible units.
lessons.conceptOverview: Units constrain valid equations and expose inconsistent inputs. Convert quantities before combining them, and distinguish rates from totals; a numerically plausible result can still be dimensionally wrong.

lessons.title: Sensitivity analysis
lessons.description: Vary output length and arrival rate and identify the dominant assumptions.
lessons.conceptOverview: Sensitivity analysis varies assumptions to see how outputs change. Local derivatives reveal nearby effects, while scenario sweeps expose nonlinear behavior and interactions outside a small neighborhood.
lessons.whyItMatters: Sensitivity analysis reveals dependence on uncertain inputs.

lessons.title: Assumptions and model mismatch
lessons.description: Identify the violated assumption and choose a more representative model.
lessons.conceptOverview: A mathematical result is conditional on its assumptions. Check independence, smoothness, stationarity or distributional conditions before applying a theorem to empirical systems.
lessons.whyItMatters: Theorem assumptions determine where a conclusion applies.

lessons.title: Capstone: audit an optimization experiment
lessons.description: Deliver equations, checks, repeated-run results and an assumption audit.
lessons.conceptOverview: Create a small reproducible optimization study with analytical gradients, finite-difference checks, stable arithmetic and uncertainty estimates. Record assumptions and failure cases as well as the best result.
lessons.whyItMatters: A mathematical experiment should validate both computation and interpretation.
